name: api-elysia
author: Marlon Chaviano
title: API with Elysia on Bun
description: End-to-end typed API with Elysia on Bun: built-in validation, OpenAPI and a typed client.

base.command: bun create elysia {{name}} && cd {{name}} && perl -pi -e 's/"moduleResolution":\s*"node(10)?"/"moduleResolution": "bundler"/' tsconfig.json

verify.command: bunx tsc --noEmit -p . && bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outdir .verify-build

instructions:
## How to work here

- Routes in `src/`, grouped with `new Elysia({ prefix: '/resource' })` and mounted with `.use()`.
- Validate params, query and body with `t` (TypeBox) on every route; types are inferred.
- Start with `bun dev`. Before finishing: `bunx tsc --noEmit`.
